title: Network Participation Agreements: Term, Renewal, Termination Notice and Re-application Periods
content:
Each type of **Network Participation Agreements** runs for a fixed initial term. It renews on its own and can be ended by written notice of a set length. This schedule gives the term, the notice periods, the re-application waits after a termination, and the DHMO member reassignment lead time for each agreement type.

| Term | Savings Network | Vision Network | DHMO Specialist | DHMO Primary Care Dentist | Premier Participating Dentist | PPO Participating Dentist |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Initial term (months) | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 |
| Renews automatically for successive terms of the same length | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Written notice the practice must give to terminate without cause (calendar days) | 30 | 60 | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 |
| Written notice Cascade must give to terminate without cause (calendar days) | 30 | 60 | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 |
| Shorter notice the practice may give after a material fee schedule reduction (calendar days) | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |
| Practice may rescind its own notice before the termination date | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Wait before a new application after a for-cause or license-action termination (calendar months) | 12 | 24 | 24 | 24 | 24 | 24 |
| Wait before a new application after a termination without cause (calendar months) | 0 | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 |
| Days before a primary care dentist's termination date by which assigned DHMO members are notified and reassigned | 0 | 0 | 0 | 30 | 0 | 0 |

## Termination date alignment

For every agreement type, the termination date is aligned to the end of the month after notice. It is the last day of the month in which the notice period ends.

## Notes on the schedule

- **Shorter notice.** After a material fee schedule reduction, the practice may give 30 calendar days of notice instead of the full notice period, if it terminates within the fee-change notice window.
- **Re-application waits.** The waits are counted in calendar months. A wait of 0 months means a new application is accepted straight away after a termination without cause under the savings network agreement.
- **Reassignment.** Assigned DHMO members exist only under the Cascade DHMO Primary Care Dentist Agreement, so the 30-day reassignment lead time applies to it alone. A value of 0 means the term does not apply.

## Hypothetical illustration

A hypothetical practice under the Cascade Vision Network Provider Agreement gives written notice on 10 March. The 60-day notice period ends on 9 May. The termination date is therefore 31 May, the last day of the month in which the notice period ends.
